rules.name: exec_from_suspicious_path

rules.description: Network activity followed by execution in a chain that includes curl or wget.

rules.description: Process has dangerous capabilities and seccomp is disabled.

rules.description: Sensitive file access followed by outbound network behavior.

rules.description: Sensitive file access followed by execve in the same process history.

rules.description: Burst network behavior in a chain that includes a container runtime.

rules.description: Process wrote and then executed the same path.

rules.description: Process opened a path that was already deleted.

rules.description: Bursty exec behavior after network activity.
